A '''mining colony''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adim]] was beset by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], forcing them to hire six [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] to protect the operation. In response, the pirates hired the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Andov Syn]] who single-handedly [[Death/Legends|killed]] all of the hired mercenaries.
